extracted.intended_audience: general readers of literary short fiction; students or practitioners of lyrical prose and narrative craft
extracted.subtask_description: Exemplar short-fiction prose showing techniques for evocative description, emotional truth in performance and writing, and character-motivated detail. Useful as a model for authors aiming for lyrical, sensory, and character-driven narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: The secret for musical expression
rubrics_metrics.description: “to know the meaning of happiness, and not to be afraid of sadness, but to pour it all into the music. That is the secret, and it will make you a musician...,”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as an artistic principle by the master: understanding both joy and sorrow and allowing both fully into performance produces authentic, transporting music. Surrounding context: the master lays his hand on her shoulder and frames this as the central quality that will carry her far if combined with disciplined practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice diligently; be 'letter-perfect'
rubrics_metrics.description: “I shall expect you to be letter-perfect with that G major concerto of Beethoven--no more drum-beats, remember.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete technical admonition emphasizing accuracy, control, and refinement of touch. The master's injunction is paired with the warning 'provided you don't neglect your practising,' linking expressive ability to steady, exacting rehearsal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid premature public performance
rubrics_metrics.description: “you are not to think of playing in public, at a concert, until I tell you. It may be a long time... I am not going to let them spoil my sweetest rose by forcing her into bloom too soon.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pedagogical guideline to protect artistic development: delay public exposure until artist is truly ready rather than rushing development for external acclaim. Illustrated by the master's protective, paternalistic approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write directly, simply, and naturally
rubrics_metrics.description: “For the first time in his life he wrote directly, simply, and naturally, describing what he had really seen, and expressing what he had really felt and imagined.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit advice embedded in narrative about effective prose: truthful, straightforward description of observed facts combined with honest expression of feeling and imagination creates compelling, publishable pieces. Example: these letters earned him commissions and renewed confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use sensory detail to evoke place and mood
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples in text: “the aromatic breath of the pine-trees and the spicy smell of wild grapes,” “the faint fragrance of the formal beds of hyacinths and tulips and jonquils,” “the delicate dusk... the windows were wide open.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrated technique: rich, concrete sensory particulars (smell, sound, light, tactile) anchor scenes and produce 'pictures that would not fade and dissolve.' Sensory specificity functions to make memories and settings unforgettable for reader and character alike.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a recurring inward standard or leitmotif to shape character perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: “that summer stayed with them both as something rare and unequalled, set apart in its delectable perfection, a standard by which, unconsciously, they measured all happiness and all beauty.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technique: a persistent memory or ideal (a leitmotif) can be used as a measuring-stick for characters' future joys and disappointments; it explains behavioral consequences (detachment, isolation) and lends thematic unity across scenes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Render remembered music and feeling with clarity and fidelity
rubrics_metrics.description: “It seemed to be singing over again the favourite song of some one who had died--singing very clearly and distinctly so as not to lose a single note, a single movement, of the unforgotten melody of happiness.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When depicting memory or nostalgia, preserve the form and detail of the remembered element precisely—sustaining clarity of image or motif so the emotional resonance remains intact. The passage shows how exact recall of sensory/musical detail heightens poignancy.
